reason: The patch moves the empty-expr filter ahead of interpolation (shardQuerySplitting.ts:49-52), so a target like '$query' that resolves to '' lands alone in the non-shardable group and is handed to runSplitQuery, which filters it out (querySplitting.ts:296-299) and calls runSplitGroupedQueries with []; there `requests.filter(...)[0].partition` throws a TypeError (querySplitting.ts:95-96; Math.max(...[]) itself only yields -Infinity) inside the un-caught `.then` at shardQuerySplitting.ts:213-215, so the Observable never emits or completes. Before the patch the shard path interpolated first and dropped such targets, so a valid query alongside an empty one worked.
